purpose: Bounded finite measured tests requested by M6 Pass C (Talisman of Indulgence vs Mox Amber, Arcane Signet alternative, Overburden as competing cut) plus token-engine and Opposition/Static Orb deployability. Seeded goldfish deployment model, not a game simulation or win rate.

mana.on: the play, no mulligans, 7 + (t-1) cards seen
mana.method: Seeded finite Monte Carlo goldfish of mana deployment only. Each turn: one land drop (fetches resolved to a typed dual/basic; under Blood Moon and Back to Basics fetches find a basic of any colour), zero-cost Moxen deployed when their condition is met (Mox Diamond discards a spare land; Chrome Mox imprints a spare nonartifact nonland card; Mox Opal live at three artifacts; Mox Amber live only once a colored legendary creature or planeswalker is on the battlefield - Ragavan, Ashiok, Narset, Sheoldred, or a commander cast at five mana), Sol Ring/Talismans/Arcane Signet cast greedily when affordable, cheapest colored legend cast when affordable. Mana Vault, Grim Monolith, Lotus Petal, Lion's Eye Diamond, Dark Ritual, Culling the Weak, Jeska's Will, Gemstone Caverns luck counter and Ancient Tomb under Damping Sphere are ignored (conservative). Lock states are applied from turn 1 as a worst case for the own deck: Contamination = every land taps for B only; Blood Moon = nonbasics tap for R only; Back to Basics = nonbasic non-fetch lands only produce mana on the turn they enter; Artifact hate = opposing Null Rod / Collector Ouphe / Stony Silence class shuts every artifact mana source. Mox Amber with only Karn produces no mana (Karn is colorless); Karn is not counted as an enabler.

tokens.method: Same deployment model and lock-state definitions as meas27_mana.json. A token engine is online on turn t if Tevesh was castable (five mana including B) on some turn <= t, or Bitterblossom was among the cards seen and two mana including B was available on some turn <= t. Opposition is castable if seen and four mana including two U-capable sources was available on some turn <= t. Tutors (Demonic Tutor, Vampiric Tutor, Imperial Seal, Diabolic Intent, Gamble, Beseech the Mirror, Wishclaw Talisman) are ignored, so single-card probabilities are lower bounds.
